items.headline: 烏俄空襲8死 約旦美軍添死傷
items.context: 烏克蘭持續對俄羅斯境內的能源與軍事目標發動無人機攻擊，這波攻擊造成至少8人死亡、超過60人受傷。同一時間，中東情勢也再度升溫——伊朗攻擊約旦境內的美軍設施，造成2名美軍死亡、1人下落不明。
items.thread_text:

同一時間，中東情勢也再度升溫。伊朗與美國本週互有攻擊，伊朗鎖定波灣地區的美軍設施，其中約旦一處遭攻擊，造成2名美軍死亡、1人下落不明。

本則整理自 NPR 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 18、19 日的報導。

items.headline: 烏軍空襲俄物流倉庫
items.context: 烏克蘭無人機攻擊了俄羅斯境內的物流倉儲設施，包括莫斯科附近與坦波夫的Wildberries倉庫。烏克蘭方面將這些設施稱為提供「受制裁零組件」的重要物流據點，這次攻擊造成人員傷亡。
items.thread_text:
烏克蘭無人機這次瞄準俄羅斯境內的物流倉儲設施，包括莫斯科附近、以及坦波夫（Tambov）的Wildberries倉庫。烏克蘭總統把這些倉庫，稱為供應「受制裁零組件」的重要物流據點。這波攻擊造成人員傷亡。

本則整理自 Al Jazeera 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 18 日的報導。

items.headline: 中國警告英國鋼鐵國有化
items.context: 英國政府將虧損中的英國鋼鐵（British Steel）全面收歸國有，中國對此提出警告，要求英方公平處理。原本擁有英國鋼鐵的中國企業敬業集團（Jingye），則以國安風險為由，要求獲得補償。
items.thread_text:
英國政府把陷入虧損的英國鋼鐵（British Steel）全面收歸國有，中國對此表達不滿，警告將採取因應措施，並要求英方公平處理這起爭議。原本持有英國鋼鐵的中國企業敬業集團（Jingye），主張自己是基於國安風險考量被迫退出，要求獲得補償。

本則整理自 Reuters 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 7 月 18 日的報導。

sources.summary: Underbelly Boulevard Soho, London A grab-bag of awkward ‘lessons learned’ by a middle-aged entertainer reflecting on her journey, the US comic’s song-filled show has savour and schmaltz Among Americans, Tony award-winner (“and four-time Tony award loser,” as she self-deprecates here) Laura Benanti is a well-loved Broadway doyenne. But prior to national treasure status (boosted by her popular Melania Trump skits in recent years), she was a blushing innocent, performing on the Great White Way aged 18, being propositioned by bigshot producers and breaking her neck in a revival of Into the Woods. A “pathological people pleaser,” she didn’t raise a fuss, and the injury was covered up. This eyebrow-raising history contains quite enough to justify a 65-minute solo show about being, in Benanti’s words, a “recovering ingenue”. And when that’s what Nobody Cares is, it’s at its strongest. Delivered with musical director Todd Almond plus two-piece backing band, the show is cringingly funny about the younger Benanti’s conflict avoidance, as she lurches from one disastrous relationships to another and squirms out of a marriage proposal in the least appropriate way imaginable. sources.summary: The actor seemed destined for a long but unflashy career in musical theatre – until a role as a football club owner in the TV hit changed everything. She talks about her new Hollywood era, calling out misogyny and why she’s ‘more than just camp’ Hannah Waddingham clears her throat. Her voice is a little scratchy. Two days before we meet, the star of Ted Lasso hosted the TV comedy show Saturday Night Live UK. She took part in almost all of the sketches that night, from a skit about “two top-heavy, Reading-based drama teachers” called Janet, to a musical number about how many glasses of wine to drink at a bar, to a bit in which she played the stern northern leader of a speed awareness course. In her opening monologue, she zipped through a variety of accents and impressions. “You see?” she told the cheering crowd. “Range! Range. ” I should have remembered this line when making small talk. We are tucked away in the hidden private dining room of a hotel in London, the city where the actor was born and raised and where she still lives with her young daughter. When Waddingham walks through the lobby, people notice her. She is tall, striking, and wearing the pulled-down baseball cap that is an actor’s day-off uniform. During lockdown, Ted Lasso – the amiable football series in which she plays Rebecca Welton, the owner of a fictional team called AFC Richmond – made her famous on both sides of the Atlantic. In 2021, it won her an Emmy award for outstanding supporting actress in a comedy series. At 47, after a long but unflashy career on stage and screen, there was a sense that her time had come. items.headline: 迦納電影海報成收藏藝術
items.context: 迦納的手繪電影海報，畫風經常誇張到偏離電影原本內容，例如把迪士尼動畫《小美人魚》畫成驚悚片風格。這種「聳動系」海報如今被當成收藏藝術品看待，但過去也曾因為誤導觀眾，引來威脅、辱罵甚至肢體衝突。
items.thread_text:
迦納的手繪電影海報，風格經常誇張到完全偏離電影原本的內容。畫師希威·傑（Heavy J，本名Jeaurs Affutu）就曾經把迪士尼動畫《小美人魚》，畫成拿刀的男子和骷髏頭，塑造出驚悚片的既視感。他說，「我們加了更多東西，是為了讓大家有興趣。」這種「聳動系」海報如今被當成收藏藝術品看待，但過去也曾因為誤導觀眾，引來威脅、辱罵甚至肢體衝突。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 18 日發佈的報導。
